profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Target | Agentic AI Tools, MCP Integrations, Oracle/Postgres Database, Spring Boot
profile.summary:
With over four years as a Senior Software Engineer at Target Corporation, I specialize in designing and developing enterprise integration applications, APIs, and web-based solutions that support large-scale fulfillment and distribution operations. My experience includes working with Oracle Database, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Manhattan Warehouse Management Systems to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, automate business processes, and enhance system stability. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges and drive impactful business outcomes.

In addition to enterprise software development, I actively leverage modern AI-assisted and agentic development technologies to accelerate solution delivery and innovation. My experience includes working with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, OpenCode, and GitHub Copilot, as well as utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and agent-driven workflows to integrate external systems, automate engineering tasks, generate documentation and test assets, and streamline development processes. I am passionate about combining traditional software engineering principles with emerging AI technologies to build practical, efficient, and scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead, developed and drove multiple integration applications & APIs with cross functional teams
•	Optimized and improved on call stability by implanting several automated solutions such as automated software restart scripts, auto detection of failures, automated certs renewal detection, improved alerting for on call
•	Lead and developed web-based solutions to eliminate dependency on software center deployments
•	Supported and maintained all technologies for fulfillment in all Target owned Fulfillment Centers
•	Developed & supported Manhattan Warehouse Management System 2013, Manhattan WMS 2019 & Touch Warehouse
•	Managed and developed several in house Fulfillment and Distribution Center applications such as Item Certification Application, Centralized First Receipt & SLAM Integrator
•	Delivering many business initiatives and goals with solutions provided through tech: Cost Accounting Controls, Item Certification, Manhattan WMS Upgrades from 2013-2019, Model 1 Flow Center & Ontrac Integration
•	Lead and drove to increase security across team’s space: increased unit, integration test coverage & introduction of cypress.io for functional testing
•	Increased team culture through tech by presenting in BeginnerCon, mentoring interns & engineers, driving team hack days, 
•	Continuous decrease in on call support & increasing stability with a 50 percent reduction goal in high priority incidents per year.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a multi-branded system to be used inside of the Powercode software that included
branding of customers, emails, system events, billing system, and customer relations
management.
• Built system wide outgoing web hooks for the Powercode software, enabling the ability to
build custom applications and a full integration with Slack.
• Developed an upgrade monitoring script that contributed to reduction in support
related calls
• Lead in the development of polymorphing Option 66 Auto Provisioning from supporting one
embedded hardware device to multiple devices (Cambium and ReadyNet).
• Managed and contributed to development of network monitoring software in Ruby on Rails
• Provided developmental support for bugs in current codebase
• Project Managed software development cycle of new software.
• Lead team in research and development of technologies to be used.
• Contributed to development of new features added to current software such as Twilio
Integration, SotalCloud Integration, Multi-Branding, Web Hooks, Ticket History, User Activity
Monitoring, and Option 66 Auto Provisioning.
• Fixed and maintained current codebase in a LAMP stack environment with Git as the version
control.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with the development of a Java based network file transfer application
•	Developed algorithm for recursively searching for specific files based on key words in Java
•	Contributed to UI/UX design of client’s commercial websites
•	Ensured and tested codebase and functionality of website products during each successful milestone
•	Contributed to development of custom made JavaScript applications for clients

positions.title: Web Administrator
positions.description:
•	Designed, managed and maintained current company website
•	Collaborated with promotional team to provide weekly events and promotions that led to monthly revenue upwards of $15000.
•	Created company’s social media platform that included Facebook, Twitter, Justin.tv, Instagram, Youtube, & SoundCloud.

projects.title: Multi Branding
projects.description: Created a built in Multi Brand system that can be used inside of the Powercode software. Expanded Emails, System Events, Billing, and Customer Portal to support Multi Branding

projects.title: Web Hooks
projects.description: Built outgoing web hooks for Powercode Software based on triggers to allow other softwares to integrate with Powercode. Built a fully integrated Slack Web Hook into the Powercode Software
